score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on adopted London/LBBD planning policy, explicit industrial-land hierarchy and prevention of strategic jobs/floorspace or historic project evidence being converted into parcel-level development entitlement.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Policy E4
sources.fact: Adopted policy requires sufficient industrial/logistics/service land and distinguishes SIL, LSIS and non-designated industrial sites; retention, enhancement and additional capacity are plan-led.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Policy E5 SIL
sources.fact: SILs are to be proactively managed; listed Barking & Dagenham SILs include Dagenham Dock/Rainham Employment Area, Rippleside and River Road Employment Area.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Policy E6 LSIS
sources.fact: LSIS boundaries and acceptable uses must be justified by local evidence; designation alone does not establish residential suitability.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Policy E7
sources.fact: Industrial intensification/co-location/substitution must be carefully coordinated and plan-led; release of land is not inferred automatically from proximity or vacancy.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Economy chapter affordable workspace
sources.fact: Economy chapter includes affordable workspace and suitable business-space policies; workspace policy is distinct from residential permission or parcel value.

sources.label: LBBD Local Plan 2020-2037 Economy chapter
sources.fact: Adopted plan economy chapter cites an estimated requirement of about 200,000 sqm floorspace and about 50 ha land for projected industrial-sector job growth; these are strategic plan requirements, not parcel-specific demand guarantees.

sources.label: LBBD Local Plan 2037
sources.fact: Adopted 18 September 2024 and sets borough homes/jobs targets plus infrastructure requirements.

sources.label: GLA Industria Barking project
sources.fact: GLA project page describes over 10,000 sqm light-industrial floorspace and 250 jobs, with page status historically 'due to complete in 2023'; this page is not treated as current completion proof.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Spatial Development Patterns
sources.fact: Opportunity Areas should plan social/other infrastructure and sustain SIL/industrial capacity while establishing growth capacity; OA context is not parcel entitlement.

sources.label: Current London Plan status
sources.fact: London Plan 2021 remains the current adopted planning framework while the next plan is being prepared.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Housing/industrial-site linkage
sources.fact: Housing intensification on industrial sites is limited to sites identified through the E4-E7 plan-led processes; industrial location alone is not residential suitability.

sources.label: Planning Data Brownfield land
sources.fact: Official brownfield register aggregation is useful candidate evidence but register membership is not exact parcel relation, planning permission, viability or delivery proof.

examples.result: Dagenham Dock/Rainham SIL status retained as industrial-policy evidence; no residential promotion inferred.
Rippleside SIL status retained; exact policy-map/site relation is required before parcel classification.
River Road Employment Area SIL status retained; industrial designation does not equal development value or release.
LBBD strategic ~200,000 sqm/~50 ha industrial requirement is borough-level evidence and not allocated to any candidate parcel.
Industria project page is treated as historic project evidence; 'due to complete in 2023' is not silently converted into verified current completion.
E7 co-location/substitution requires plan-led evidence; proximity to SIL cannot create residential entitlement.
Brownfield-register membership is separated from industrial-land policy and exact site geometry.
No economic/industrial promotion occurs without exact current designation, site relation and applicable adopted-policy evidence.
